issues.on_page: Local 145,270 (Exhibit F); General column of Exhibit D p4: Charges for Services 92,372 + Interest 42,013 + Miscellaneous 8,694 + Intergovernmental 2,191 (7,777 - State 5,586)
issues.issue: [fixed] Broad 'Local' group is mostly charges for services (64%). The mixed-line rule calls for the dominant category (charges for services/fees, detail 'other charges for services') with a review note naming the mix, not 'other'.

Extractor rules put noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The statement counts it in Public Works, so streets/highways is defensible. But Economic Development (detail[14]) was moved out of its printed function, so the two lines are handled inconsistently.
